summary: Reset TODO and hot memory around the `neon` extraction cleanup so PojoLens could return focus to the Java library plus repo-memory helpers.
Removed the extracted local AI tooling surface and obsolete Python-only coverage from PojoLens after that runtime moved to the separate `neon` codebase.
Removed the remaining extracted runtime artifacts and scrubbed the active changelog plus repo-memory history so PojoLens no longer carries the old extracted-runtime track.

Repaired the failed `2026.05.18.1353` release aftermath by backfilling `release-2026.05.18.1353` on `main` and wiring Central wait mode through Maven properties so the workflow only blocks for final publication when `wait_until=published` is selected.

Updated consumer-facing install docs to published release `2026.05.18.1353` and changed the doc-consistency scripts to validate those snippets against the latest `release-*` tag while leaving local example builds pinned to the checked-in root POM version.

Added `feature-audit.md` with a product-surface inventory, no P0 blocker, and prioritized gaps around README Java requirement drift, typed parity APIs, string matching, time buckets, sorting, typed reports, natural pagination, and stale memory facts.

Completed WP-12 typed pagination, WP-13 hourly time buckets, WP-16 natural pagination parity, and related quick fixes. `PageResult` now exposes `totalRows()`, typed pages use limit/offset with an unpaged count pass, natural pages delegate to SQL-like pagination, and `TimeBucket.HOUR` works across query surfaces.

Completed WP-15 by adding `ReportDefinition.typed(...)` and typed chart overloads, plus `TypedQuery.schema(Projection.class)` for data-free reusable schema metadata, with focused contract/public-API coverage and docs updates.
Completed WP-17 by adding `TypedQuery.diagnostics()` plus typed `planPreview()` review models for no-data query-shape inspection, with contract/public-API coverage and typed-guide updates.

Completed WP-18 to WP-28 and WP-30 (uncommitted): stream loaders, core correctness passes, SQL-like/natural filtering parity (IN lists, IS NULL, BETWEEN, NOT, negated text matching via Clauses.NOT_CONTAINS/NOT_MATCHES, LIKE/ILIKE, natural ignoring case), SELECT DISTINCT and COUNT(DISTINCT), and statistical aggregates (MEDIAN, PERCENTILE, STDDEV, VARIANCE). New SQL words (IS, LIKE, ILIKE, ESCAPE, DISTINCT, statistic names) are contextual, not reserved. All release gates pass; 1393 runtime tests. Next: WP-31 (LAG/LEAD), WP-29 needs a design note.

Completed WP-31 (uncommitted, design note docs/design/wp-31-window-gaps.md): LAG/LEAD offset windows (PostgreSQL semantics, literal offset/default, no frame) on SQL-like, typed lag/lead, natural previous/next, and fluent addOffsetWindow; windows and QUALIFY over grouped rows after HAVING on all surfaces. New single owners: WindowFunction.fromName, WindowExpressionText, WindowOffsetDefaults, QueryMetric.outputType. AGGREGATE telemetry now fires after HAVING with rowsAfterHaving. 1494 runtime tests; all gates pass. Next: WP-32.

WP-31 committed as 480966f. Completed WP-32 (uncommitted): TypedQuery validates joined queries against the entity fields merged with each joined source (JoinFieldNames child_ rule, now the single owner replacing four copies) and checks join keys; classes come from bound rows or the new join(sourceName, sourceClass, ...) overload, so diagnostics()/planPreview() validate without data. 1501 runtime tests; all gates pass. Next: WP-33 (lazy typed stream).

WP-32 committed as e6937e9. Completed WP-33 (uncommitted): typed stream()/iterator() delegate to Filter.stream; FastPojoStreamSupport now evaluates WHERE rule groups lazily through FilterCore.matchesWhereGroups, so typed predicates and SQL-like/natural OR/NOT stream row by row. Ordered/grouped/windowed/distinct/joined/computed/guarded shapes still materialise. Streaming JMH: typed first page 9.2 us vs 757 us materialised. 1508 runtime tests; all gates pass. TODO backlog is empty; next is a release cut or a new audit.
